body:
VERDICT: BLOCK exact 59a557b8680a297316e888d0d1b2679955e3d512. One docs path; parent e584ad6; git diff --check clean. The prior finite admission, typed outcomes, budget, rank-scope, fusion, manual authority, and four-door construction blockers are closed.

HIGH — source and recall identity are named but not proven. Section 5 says the checked bundle binds exact source-view and recall/transcript identity, but neither section 3 nor section 6 requires the factory to derive those identities from the actual SourceView and RecallGraph. No named mutation substitutes a foreign view or recall, removes an admitted anchor from the view, or changes transcript content while retaining the claimed identity. This is a live seam: GraphHsmm.infer at hsmm.scala:520-528 silently filters anchors absent from the view before HsmmResult.validated; run repeats that filtering at :571-590. A future implementation can therefore retain a bundle over one anchor set while inference and HsmmResult publish a smaller set, and every current M1-M13 court can still pass. Required successor: require smart construction from the actual checked recall and view, derive both identities, refuse evaluated/manual anchors outside the bound view, remove the silent effective-set ambiguity, and add same-input mutations for foreign view, foreign recall/transcript, and view-absent anchor.

HIGH — complete provider outcomes still permit credence erasure. The verified constructor is Estimate.Observed(value, credence), and section 2.1 says the ledger records what the provider actually returned, but the admitted outcome contract and mutations mention only Observed(v). Two attempts with equal v and different Credence or calibration model may remain indistinguishable. State that the complete outcome retains the credence coordinate and add a drop-or-substitute-credence mutation, or explicitly justify its exclusion from the audit identity.

MEDIUM / SHOULD-HAVE-CHANGED — ablation publication remains outside the migration inventory. Section 5.1 requires original availability plus ablation policy/outcome, but section 8 names HsmmResult, AlignWire, codec, CandidateSet, Candidates and fuse; current AblationResult at hsmm.scala:483-487 and :541-553 carries only rows, path and log-likelihood. M9 can pass on the pre-inference bundle while the published ablation result still loses which channel/policy produced it. Name the carrier or companion identity and a publication mutation.

PLAN RECONCILIATION: the chief amendments and our earlier rank/nonfinite findings are addressed; original bead courts for foreign recall/source identity and reproducible ablation are not yet executable. ERGONOMIC RECONCILIATION: docs-only, so no runtime API ergonomics to assess. VERIFIED: exact diff, candidates.scala source checklist, Estimate and HsmmResult/GraphHsmm/AblationResult paths. INFERRED: the successor vocabulary and carrier shape remain ADR work.
